en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Humran who said,

‘Ismail, son of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> fell sick, so Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said him: ‘Say, ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>!’, ten times, for the one who says that, would be called out: ‘At your service! What is your need?’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father all have narrated from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Muhammad ibn Humran who has said the following:

“When Isma’il son of abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) became ill, abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) told him to say, ‘Ten times; O Lord.’ Whoever says this will be called, ‘Your call is heard and well noticed, ask what kind of help do you need?”’
